customManagers.description: OpenWrt release. One pin, restated in ~30 places: the SDK the feed builds against, the CI env, the image the QEMU harness boots, and the docs that quote it. All of them are one dep so a bump arrives as a single PR and the prose cannot drift from the pin. The patterns are deliberately non-overlapping -- no two may match the same literal, or the second update would look for a replaceString the first already rewrote. Renovate compiles these with RE2, so lookaround is unavailable: the ` SDK` variants are separated by anchoring on the preceding token instead.
Upstream lynxthecat/cake-autorate release built by the OpenWrt package

packageRules.description: OpenWrt bumps carry a companion sha256 (and possibly a new toolchain string) that Renovate cannot compute -- always human-driven
prBodyNotes: **Manual follow-up required before this can merge.**

- `tests/integration/run.sh`: `IMG_SHA256` still names the OLD image. Refresh it from `https://downloads.openwrt.org/releases/<version>/targets/x86/64/sha256sums` (the entry for `openwrt-<version>-x86-64-generic-ext4-combined.img.gz`), or the integration job aborts with `image sha256 mismatch`.

- `.github/workflows/build.yml`: `SDK_NAME` / `SDK_ARCHIVE` also embed the compiler and libc (`gcc-14.3.0_musl`). If the new release changed the toolchain the SDK download 404s -- check that release's `targets/x86/64/` listing and update both names.

- On a MINOR or MAJOR bump only, the deliberately-fuzzy two-component series strings are left alone by design and need a look: the `DISTRIB_RELEASE=` boot assertion in `tests/integration/lib/harness.py` and its module docstring, the table row in `tests/integration/README.md`, and the `apk` note in `README.md`. Patch bumps need no action there.
- `docs/testing.md` links the README anchor `#building-with-the-openwrt-251205-sdk`, which is derived from the version with the dots stripped. Re-point it whenever the README heading moves.

packageRules.description: An upstream cake-autorate bump needs a new PKG_HASH, which Renovate cannot compute -- always human-driven
prBodyNotes: **Manual follow-up required before this can merge.**

- `net/cake-autorate/Makefile`: `PKG_HASH` still names the OLD tarball. Regenerate it with `make package/cake-autorate/download V=s` in the SDK, or `curl -sL 'https://codeload.github.com/lynxthecat/cake-autorate/tar.gz/refs/tags/v<version>' | sha256sum`.

- Leave `PKG_RELEASE` ALONE. `.github/scripts/package-versions.sh` owns it and resets it to 1 on an upstream bump; `release.yml` runs the check before it will publish a tag, so a stale value is caught there with the expected number. Two owners for one field is how v0.1.0 and v0.2.0 came to ship different payloads under the same `-r1`.
- Re-check `docs/upstream-option-inventory.md` and the UCI bridge for options added, renamed or removed upstream.

packageRules.description: Tagged action releases: cooldown, then automerge
Major action bumps: same cooldown, still automerged -- CI builds the feed and boots the VM, so a breaking action fails visibly rather than silently

Pure digest moves: a tag that now resolves to a different commit is the shape a retag attack takes, and there is no release timestamp for minimumReleaseAge to bite on, so these never automerge. `helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests` above is what puts every `uses:` on a sha in the first place -- without it this rule matches nothing.
Playwright and the rest of the UI test tooling: minor/patch automerge, gated on the visual suite that renders against the pinned snapshots
A Playwright major can change how Chromium rasterises the LuCI forms, which means regenerating every snapshot in tests/ui/**-snapshots -- review by hand
prBodyNotes: If the visual suite fails on pixel diffs rather than behaviour, regenerate the baselines with `npm run test:visual:update` in `tests/ui/` and review the gallery before merging.
